'''''Thought: A Journal of Philosophy''''' is a quarterly [[peer review|peer-reviewed]] [[academic journal]] published by the [[Philosophy Documentation Center]] in cooperation with the Thought Trust.  The journal covers [[logic]], [[philosophy of mathematics]], [[philosophy of mind]], [[epistemology]], [[philosophy of language]], and [[metaphysics]].  The [[editor-in-chief|editors-in-chief]] are [[Crispin Wright]] (Universities of Stirling and New York), John Divers ([[University of Leeds]]), and [[Kathrin Glüer-Pagin]] ([[Stockholm University]]). From 2012 to 2021 this journal was published by [[Wiley-Blackwell]].

== Abstracting and indexing ==
''Thought: A Journal of Philosophy'' is abstracted and indexed in [[Academic OneFile]], [[Arts & Humanities Citation Index]], [[The Philosopher's Index]], [[PhilPapers]], and [[Scopus]].
